title: A Crab That Climbs Trees Pinches Harder Than a Bear Bites

scenes.text: A crab that climbs trees can pinch harder than a bear can bite.
The coconut crab is the largest land crab on Earth, about three feet across.
Researchers tested twenty-nine wild crabs, and the bigger the crab, the harder the pinch.
The biggest ones, around nine pounds, pinch with about thirty-three hundred newtons.
A black bear bites with about seventeen hundred. A wolf, about twelve hundred. A human, about seven hundred and fifty.
On land, the only predator that would out-clamp it is the alligator.

A crab that climbs trees can pinch harder than a bear can bite.
Coconut crabs reach about 3,300 newtons, nearly double a black bear's bite.
Which animal would you least want to arm wrestle?
